applies_on: Dot E2 branch cocos/wechat-world-r5-e2-20261009, on top of 0001 (084a27b) + 0002 (5d0e931): git am --directory=creator-build-project 0001-0001b-*.patch. 0003 (region_skycity) is out of scope.

fixes.black_screen: WorldIntegrationBoot.start setMaterial crash (illegal property albedo/roughness, localSetLayout undefined). start() now only creates the reference capsule mesh, hidden; material is applied in mountWorld() after the island prefab (and its effect) has loaded, via applyMarkerMaterial(): EffectAsset.get check, builtin-standard preferred, builtin-unlit fallback, stays hidden if neither; wrapped in try so it never blocks startup.
fixes.engine_module_trimming: settings/v2/packages/engine.json: physics (3D+2D) removed, plus spine, dragon-bones, particle, rich-text, mask, tiled-map, terrain, video, webview, xr, light-probe, marionette, websocket etc. Kept: base, webgl/webgl2, 2d, 3d, ui, graphics, animation, skeletal-animation, primitive, profiler, tween, audio, default custom-pipeline. No physics components found in scripts/scenes/prefabs.

editor_steps_for_dot: Project Settings > Bundle config: new config, WeChat mini-game compression type = mini-game subpackage.
Apply that config to assets/bundles/region_island and assets/resources.
Build panel: main package compression type = mini-game subpackage; disable separate engine.
